data.name: Nazeh
data.gender_notes: Nazeh is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'nazaha', which means 'to be watchful or attentive'. In Islamic context, Nazeh is a spiritual name that signifies being aware of Allah's presence and guarding one's actions and thoughts accordingly. The name Nazeh carries the meaning “Watchful, attentive, careful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nazeh usually hope their child will grow to embody watchful, attentive, careful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder to stay mindful and focused on the path of righteousness
data.etymology: Nazeh belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Watchful, attentive, careful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nazeh total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: ناظه
in_arabic.meaning: ناظه تعني الشخص الذي يراقب وينظر بإنتباه
in_arabic.long_meaning: ناظه هو اسم مشتق من الفعل نَظَرَ، والذي يعني النظر بإنتباه ومراقبة. في اللغة العربية، يُستخدم هذا الاسم للإشارة إلى الشخص الذي يتميز بالإنتباه الشديد ومراقبة الأمور بدقة. وفي السياق الإسلامي، يمكن أن يُربط هذا الاسم بآية من القرآن الكريم حيث يُذكر النظر والمراقبة كصفة من صفات الله تعالى.

in_urdu.name: ناظہ
in_urdu.meaning: ناظہ کا مطلب ہے جو مخصوص توجہ سے دیکھتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: ناظہ ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے 'وہ شخص جو خاص توجہ سے دیکھتا ہے'۔ یہ نام 'نَظَرَ' فعل سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے دیکھنا یا نظر انداز کرنا۔ اسلامی ثقافت میں، یہ نام ان خصوصیات کی نمائندگی کرتا ہے جو ایک مسلمان کے لیے ضروری ہیں، جیسے کہ غور و خوض اور سوچ ب فکر۔

in_hindi.name: नाज़ेह
in_hindi.meaning: नाज़ेह का अर्थ है जो विशेष ध्यान से देखता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाज़ेह एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है 'वह व्यक्ति जो विशेष ध्यान से देखता है'। यह नाम 'नज़र' शब्द से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है देखना या दृष्टि डालना। इस्लामी परंपरा में, यह नाम उन गुणों का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है जो एक मुसलमान के लिए आवश्यक हैं, जैसे कि ध्यान से देखना और सोच विचार करना।

in_pashto.name: ناظه
in_pashto.meaning: ناظه دى هغه چا چې په پام سره ګوري
in_pashto.long_meaning: ناظه د عربي اصل يو نوم دى، چې مانا يې دى 'هغه څوک چې په پام سره ګوري'. دا نوم د 'نَظَرَ' کلمې څخه اخيستل شوى دى، چې په عربي ژبه کې د ليدو يا پاملرنې معنی ورکوي. په اسلامي کلتور کې، دا نوم د هغو ځانګړتيو استازیتوب کوي چې د يو مسلمان لپاره ضروري دي، لکه د پام سره ليدل او غور اخستل.

in_english.name: Nazeh
in_english.meaning: Nazeh means one who watches, observes, or looks with attention
in_english.long_meaning: The name Nazeh, of Arabic origin, means 'one who watches' or 'observes'. Etymologically derived from the Arabic root 'n-z-r', which conveys the sense of looking or watching. In Islamic tradition, this name symbolizes the qualities of vigilance, attention, and contemplation. Historically, it reflects the importance of being mindful and observant, traits highly valued in Muslim cultures.

pronunciation.urdu: اردو میں تلفظ کی تفصیل ناظہ (NAH-zeh)
pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل ناظه (NAH-zeh)

data.cultural_impact: In Arabic cultures, the name Nazeh is often given to children as a reminder to be mindful and observant of their surroundings, making them responsible and attentive individuals in society.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Nazeh represents a deep connection with Allah and a commitment to following His commandments. It is a constant reminder to be watchful of one's thoughts, actions, and intentions, and to strive towards leading a virtuous and righteous life. In the Prophetic tradition, Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said that Allah is with His servant as long as he remembers Him, so the name Nazeh is a powerful reminder to keep Allah in one's thoughts at all times. Additionally, it is believed that being attentive and watchful helps one to avoid committing sins and to strengthen one's faith and devotion to Allah. Overall, the name Nazeh embodies the essence of mindfulness, awareness, and accountability, leaving a lasting impact on the spiritual growth and development of its bearer.
